description: One source-selected incoming worker with a combined four-task FIFO and bounded physical deferral.
turn: One combined four-position logical/physical FIFO, selected again against the actual source after runtime adoption.
continuation: Same source selection as processing; foreign-source work stays pending without immediate continuation.
physicalDeferral: Keeps generation, source, head, membership, limited and inventory; moves only the captured FIFO position and persists30s to5min backoff.
queueContention: A known compare-and-set miss with valid retained capture returns1s retry; it neither blocks work nor creates durable per-room delay.
writeReplyLossWitness: Exact converted/deferred task remains sufficient after producer cursor updates; uncertain writes without that witness preserve their failure.
remaining: Logical/scan write witnesses under concurrent producer changes
